updates.title: What's new
updates.description: See new versions and update when you want. Nothing runs automatically.
updates.safeBody: Your automations, Instagram accounts, and database stay in place. We only apply additive migrations and restart the app when you confirm.
updates.availableHint: Review what's new below, then update when you're ready.
updates.oneClickHint: One-click is off on this server. Copy the steps for your install type — they won't wipe .env or your data.
updates.howToHint: Pick how you installed Flowcomments. Copy, paste in your server terminal, done.
updates.whatsNewHint: What changed in each version from the public repository.
updates.noNotes: No detailed notes for this version.
updates.guaranteeData: Postgres data and Redis queues are kept
updates.guaranteeEnv: .env secrets are never deleted by the updater
updates.guaranteeOptIn: Update only happens when you click / run the steps

language.title: Language
language.description: English is the default. Brazilian visitors get Portuguese automatically; you can override anytime.
